If the argument is not an array or union exclusively of array types, the return type of `array_filter` is considered to be `false`. See https://phpstan.org/r/4835caf7-8582-4d72-8a34-b99a9b1867f8

https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan/blob/4d8690c1809f298add13c3f2cc6d14b02f2a21f3/src/Type/Php/ArrayFilterFunctionReturnTypeReturnTypeExtension.php#L45-L49

https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan/blob/4d8690c1809f298add13c3f2cc6d14b02f2a21f3/src/Type/TypeUtils.php#L16-L19

`ArrayFilterFunctionReturnTypeReturnTypeExtension` calls `TypeUtils::getArrays()`, this function will return an empty array on a mixed type or union with one or more non-array types (see `TypeUtils::map()`).

This causes the type extension to return `false` instead of returning `array|false`.

`TypeUtils::map()` shouldn't return an empty array if there is a non-array type, but just return all array types or a general array type on `mixed`. Than if there is union with a non-array type or in case of `mixed`, `false` should be added as possible return type.

_Before making the change, we need to check if modifying `TypeUtils::map()` doesn't break other rules._

There should just be a special handling of mixed in this extension,
changing TypeUtils behaviour would break many other things.

In that case, we need to go over all the array function extensions and see if this issue applies to that function as well.

Yep, that's true. What I usually do in that case is that I return BenevolentUnionType. In that case, it doesn't say that `=== false` is always false, but also doesn't complain when returning benevolent union of `foo|false` from function that's supposed to return just `foo`. Because `mixed` might be correct but it also not might be correct...
@ondrejmirtes anything I can do to help?

Yeah, send a PR that updates the extension 😊
